text.17:107: Say: Believe therein or believe not, lo! those who were given knowledge before it, when it is read unto them, fall down prostrate on their faces, adoring,
text.17:109: They fall down on their faces, weeping, and it increaseth humility in them.
text.36:8: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
